errors.ORDER_NOT_OPEN: Only unpaid orders can be kept reserved.
errors.ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE: Only unpaid orders can be cancelled here. Paid orders are cancelled with the refund form.
errors.ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE: This order is cancelled or expired and cannot receive payments.
errors.NOTHING_TO_SEND: There is no e-mail for the current state of this order.
errors.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The currency does not match the order.
errors.ORDER_NOT_PAID: Tickets exist for paid orders only.
errors.NO_TICKETS: This order has no valid tickets yet.
errors.ORDER_NOT_REFUNDABLE: Only paid orders can be cancelled and refunded.
errors.ORDER_CHANGED: The order was changed in the meantime. Please reload the page and check the tickets again.
errors.ITEMS_NOT_REFUNDABLE: Some of the selected tickets are not active any more (already cancelled or refunded). Please reload the page.
errors.REFUND_NOT_RETRYABLE: Only failed automatic refunds can be retried.
errors.REFUND_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND: There is no open review for this order.
errors.REFUND_NOT_MANUAL: This refund is executed automatically by the payment provider.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_NOT_HIGHER: The new tariff must cost more than the price paid.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_NOT_POSSIBLE: Only paid orders can get a tariff change.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_NOT_POSSIBLE_REFUNDED: The tariff of a partially refunded order cannot be changed.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_NOT_POSSIBLE_COMPLIMENTARY: Complimentary orders cannot get an additional payment.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_ALREADY_OPEN: This order already has an open additional payment.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_NOT_OPEN: This additional payment is not open any more.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_NOT_PAYABLE: This additional payment cannot be paid any more.
errors.TARIFF_NOT_ALLOWED: This tariff is not offered for the selected ticket.
errors.ITEM_NOT_ACTIVE: Only active tickets can be changed.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_OPEN: This ticket has an open additional payment (tariff change). Reset the tariff first.
errors.INVOICE_REPAIR_NOT_POSSIBLE: The invoice of a refunded order cannot be repaired automatically.
errors.NO_OVERPAYMENT: This order has no overpayment to refund.
errors.CREDIT_REQUIRES_FINANCE: Only finance can credit an overpayment against a tariff change.
errors.OVERPAYMENT_CHANGED: The overpayment changed in the meantime – reload the page.
errors.REFUND_REVIEW_OPEN: PayPal refunds of this order are on hold: PayPal shows a refund that is not recorded here. Open “Open refunds” and record or resolve it first.
errors.REFUND_EXISTING_MISMATCH: The selected tickets (and fees) do not add up to the amount of the PayPal refund.
errors.PAYPAL_REFUND_NOT_COMPLETED: This PayPal refund is not completed at PayPal.
errors.PAYPAL_REFUND_MISMATCH: This PayPal refund does not belong to a payment of this order (or has another currency).
errors.PAYPAL_REFUND_ALREADY_RECORDED: This PayPal refund is already recorded.

admin.title: Orders
admin.description: Search orders, check payment status and handle unpaid bank transfers.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Order number, name, e-mail or payment reference

types.external_refund_notice: Refund reported by the payment provider
types.shortfall_written_off: Small underpayment written off (within the matching tolerance)
types.adjustment_confirmed: Additional payment confirmed by the customer
types.adjustment_reminder_sent: Reminder for the additional payment sent

detail.ticketsVoided: {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} voided
detail.priceOverrides: {count, plural, one {# price override} other {# price overrides}}
detail.blockedSold: {count, plural, one {# blocked seat sold} other {# blocked seats sold}}
detail.notMailed: No e-mail address – nothing was sent
detail.ticketsReissued: {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} re-issued
detail.settledByCredit: Settled with the overpayment – nothing to pay

email.title: E-mail: {template}
email.subject: Subject: {subject}
email.failed: Failed after {attempts, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}: {error}

feedback.keepReservedOn: The order is kept reserved and will not be cancelled automatically.
feedback.keepReservedOff: “Keep reserved” removed – the automatic deadline applies again.
feedback.cancelled: The order has been cancelled and its seats released.
feedback.paymentRecorded: Payment recorded – the order is paid.
feedback.paymentPartial: Partial payment recorded – the order still has an outstanding amount.
feedback.ticketsQueued: The tickets have been queued for sending.
feedback.paidCancelledAutomatic: Cancelled. {amount} is being refunded to the customer via PayPal automatically.
feedback.paidCancelledManual: Cancelled. {amount} must now be refunded manually – see “Open refunds”.
feedback.paidCancelledMixed: Cancelled. {amount} in total: part is refunded via PayPal automatically, the rest must be refunded manually – see “Open refunds”.
feedback.paidCancelledNoRefund: Cancelled. There is no money to refund.
feedback.refundRetried: The refund has been queued again.
feedback.refundCompleted: The refund has been marked as done.
feedback.refundAlreadyCompleted: This refund was already marked as done.
feedback.adjustmentProposed: Additional payment requested. The ticket stays valid until it is paid.
feedback.adjustmentProposedNoMail: Additional payment requested, but the order has no e-mail address – nothing was sent.
feedback.adjustmentCancelled: Additional payment cancelled – the tariff stays as it was sold.
feedback.adjustmentPaymentRecorded: Payment recorded – tariff, tickets and invoice were updated.
feedback.invoiceRepaired: Invoice corrected: credit note and new invoice issued.
feedback.restoreReviewResolved: The restore review was marked as reviewed.
feedback.invoiceUpToDate: The invoice is already up to date.
feedback.adjustmentSettledByCredit: The tariff was changed and settled with the overpayment. The customer was e-mailed the new tickets.
feedback.existingRefundRecorded: The existing PayPal refund was recorded: tickets cancelled, credit note issued, nothing was sent to PayPal.
feedback.reconciliationSkipped: The PayPal reconciliation was skipped. Automatic refunds resume.

keepReserved.title: Keep reserved
keepReserved.description: Unpaid bank transfer orders are cancelled automatically after the deadline. Keep this order reserved, e.g. when the customer announced a late payment.
keepReserved.label: Never cancel automatically

payment.title: Record payment
payment.description: For payments that were not matched automatically (e.g. transfer without reference, cash).

cancel.title: Cancel order
cancel.description: Cancels the unpaid order and releases its seats immediately.

resend.title: Send e-mail again
resend.description: Sends the e-mail that matches the current order state again (payment instructions, confirmation or cancellation).

resendTickets.title: Send tickets again
resendTickets.description: Sends the tickets of this paid order again with the ticket PDF attached.

cancelPaid.title: Cancel & refund
cancelPaid.description: Cancels the selected tickets of this paid order, releases the seats, voids the tickets and issues a credit note. PayPal payments are refunded automatically; bank transfers must be refunded by hand (“Open refunds”).
cancelPaid.noActiveItems: There are no active tickets left in this order.
cancelPaid.selection: {count, plural, =0 {No ticket selected} one {# ticket selected} other {# tickets selected}}
cancelPaid.confirm: Yes, cancel the selected tickets and refund them

changeSeats.title: Change seats
changeSeats.description: Moves tickets of this order to other seats with the same price. Paid tickets get a new QR code, the old ones become invalid.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.confirmDone: The money has been paid back to the customer.
refunds.confirmDoneBatch: The money has been paid back to the customer (all open transfers of this cancellation).

refundsPage.title: Open refunds
refundsPage.description: Refunds that need attention: bank transfers to pay back by hand, and PayPal refunds that failed or are stuck.

restoreReview.title: Needs review after restore
restoreReview.description: These orders disagree with PayPal (after a backup restore, or PayPal announced a refund that was not made here). Nothing was booked automatically. If the money already went back, record the existing PayPal refund – do NOT cancel the order normally, that would refund twice. Mark the entry as reviewed when nothing is missing.

kinds.UNKNOWN_AT_PAYPAL: PayPal shows a refund of {amount} ({ref}) that is not recorded here.
kinds.EXTERNAL_REFUND_NOTICE: PayPal announced a refund of {amount} ({ref}) that was not made through this system.
kinds.DOUBLE_REFUND_AT_PAYPAL: PayPal holds more than one completed refund for the same refund request ({detail}): possible double payout, total {amount}.
kinds.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: PayPal’s refund {ref} ({amount}) differs from the recorded refund ({detail}).
kinds.LOCAL_SUCCEEDED_NOT_AT_PAYPAL: A refund of {amount} is recorded here as done, but PayPal does not show it as completed ({ref}).
kinds.UNCHECKED_AT_PAYPAL: PayPal does not know the PayPal order {ref}, but refunds exist here. Check the PayPal account / environment.
kinds.CHECK_FAILED: PayPal refused to look up the PayPal order {ref}: {detail}

restoreReview.hold: Automatic PayPal refunds of this order are on hold until this is resolved.

record.hint: Cancels the selected tickets, issues the credit note and books the PayPal refund as done. Nothing is sent to PayPal; the refund is verified there first. The tickets (and fees) must add up to the refund amount.
record.fees: The refund includes the service fees
record.notify: Send the refund e-mail to the customer
record.confirm: The refund really exists at PayPal
record.mode: What did the refund pay back?

reconcile.title: PayPal reconciliation after restore
reconcile.pending: After the restore the refunds are being compared with PayPal. Automatic refunds wait until this is done.
reconcile.failing: The comparison with PayPal did not finish yet (attempt {attempts}) and is retried automatically. Automatic refunds wait.
reconcile.mostlyNotFound: PayPal does not know most of the orders. The restored data probably belongs to another PayPal account or environment (live/sandbox). Check the PayPal settings.
reconcile.skipConfirm: I understand: refunds are sent without comparing them with PayPal (risk of double refunds).

seatChange.title: Change seats
seatChange.heading: Change seats – order {number}
seatChange.chooseEvent: This order contains several events. Choose the event whose seats you want to change.
seatChange.noItems: This order has no seat tickets that can be moved (cancelled, refunded, standing spots or order not changeable).
seatChange.howTo: Select a ticket on the right, then click a free seat on the plan. Click another seat of this order to swap the two tickets. The new seat must have the same price.
seatChange.priceDiffers: Price differs ({expected} instead of {current}) – cancel the ticket and sell a new one instead.
seatChange.tariffNotAllowed: This tariff is not available on that seat.
seatChange.holdExpired: The hold expired – the selected new seats were cleared.
seatChange.allowBlockedHint: Press, VIP and technical seats can be selected as well.
seatChange.notify: Send the new tickets to the customer by e-mail
seatChange.noEmail: The order has no e-mail address – nothing will be sent.
seatChange.walletNote: Apple / Google Wallet passes that were already added keep the old seat. The customer should use the new PDF.
seatChange.unpaidNote: The order is not paid yet: no tickets exist, so no e-mail is sent. The tickets are issued with the new seats after payment.
seatChange.confirm: Change {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}
seatChange.done: Seats changed. {count, plural, one {# new ticket} other {# new tickets}} issued.
seatChange.doneMail: Seats changed. {count, plural, one {# new ticket} other {# new tickets}} issued and sent to the customer.

adjustment.title: Change tariff
adjustment.description: Switch tickets to a higher-priced tariff (e.g. reduced → normal). The customer gets a payment request and must confirm it; the tickets stay valid until the additional payment arrives.
adjustment.noOptions: No higher-priced tariff is available for these tickets.
adjustment.notify: Send the payment request by e-mail
adjustment.noEmail: No e-mail address on the order – nothing will be sent
adjustment.confirm: I confirm that the selected tickets are switched to the higher tariff and the customer has to pay the difference.
adjustment.openDescription: Order and tickets stay unchanged until the money arrives. Reset the tariff to cancel the request, or cancel the ticket on this page.

record.title: Record payment
record.overpaymentWarning: This order already has an overpayment of {amount} (not part of this request). Check that the money is not the same transfer before recording it.

cancel.title: Reset tariff
cancel.description: Cancels the request. Nothing else needs undoing – the order was not changed.

adjustment.summaryCredit: Credited from the overpayment already received: −{credit}
adjustment.summaryNothingToPay: Nothing to pay – the change is applied immediately.
adjustment.notifyForced: The customer is always e-mailed (new tickets)
adjustment.creditFinanceOnly: This order has an overpayment of {credit}. Only finance can credit it against a tariff change – ask a finance user.

adjustmentsPage.title: Open additional payments
adjustmentsPage.description: Tariff changes the customer has not paid yet. After the automatic reminder you decide: reset the tariff, cancel the ticket on the order page, or record the payment.

corrections.title: Invoices to correct
corrections.description: The invoice of these orders was not corrected automatically after an additional payment. “Correct invoice” issues a full credit note and a new invoice over the current order.

overpayment.title: Overpayment
overpayment.text: This order is fully paid but {amount} too much was received. Refund it, or it is credited automatically if you change a tariff.
overpayment.confirm: Refund {amount} to the customer (PayPal automatically, otherwise as an open transfer).
overpayment.reserved: {amount} of the overpayment is used by the open tariff change and is not included here.

eventPayments.title: Payment methods & bank transfer deadlines
eventPayments.hint: Empty / “inherit” uses the global setting. For orders with several events the strictest deadlines apply.
eventPayments.cancelAfterDaysHint: Only used with “own number of days”.
eventPayments.disableDaysBeforeEvent: No bank transfer within (days before the event)

boxOffice.title: Box office
boxOffice.description: Sell tickets over the counter: pick seats on the plan, take cash or card, or hand out complimentary tickets.
boxOffice.noEvents: There are no events to sell tickets for.
boxOffice.empty: Click seats on the plan or choose standing spots.
boxOffice.priceOverrideHint: Changes the price of this ticket. A reason is required.
boxOffice.allowBlockedHint: Blocked seats (press, VIP, technical) become selectable and keep their cross mark.
boxOffice.complimentaryHint: Complimentary tickets cost nothing, carry no fees and get no invoice.

buyer.title: Buyer (optional)
buyer.required: Above {limit} the invoice needs the buyer's name and full address.

success.title: Sale completed
success.ticketsNotReady: The tickets are still being created – open the PDF again in a moment.

hold.expired: The hold expired – the selection was cleared.
